title: How big is a 1 carat marquise?

hook.text: How big is a 1 carat marquise?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat marquise?
post.caption:
A 1 carat marquise measures about 10.4 by 5.2 millimeters. A 2 carat marquise covers 40% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Marquise diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/marquise-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts
